notes.title: It's Oktoberfest Time: Update 1.1.4 Adds New Outfits and Fixes to Hell Pie! 🍻
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35809888/332959e048d2bacd26a617dc485cb49be863e6bb.jpg[/img]

Grüß Gott, dear platformers!

It's finally that time again: Tomorrow, the world's biggest booze-up finally starts in idyllic Munich (after two alcohol-free years of corona-induced break): [b]Oktoberfest[/b]! So grab your dirndl, lederhosen and chamois beard and get the party started! 🍻

And where alcohol excesses take place, Nate and Nugget are not far behind! And that's why the new [b]Hell Pie[/b] update 1.1.4 - in celebration of Oktoberfest starting tomorrow - brings new outfits into play:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35809888/8e8e697354ada07c4cc84665c8627200d648c740.jpg[/img]

In addition, a few small problems are fixed. Here is the complete (tiny) changelog:
[list][*] Lederhose + Dirndl outfit added
[*] Beermug outfit for Nugget added
[*] Various localization fixes
[*] Various minor fixes[/list]
Have a great time swinging with lerderhosen Nate and dirndl Nugget!
Sluggerfly out ❤️

notes.title: 🛠️ Hell Pie Update 1.1.3 is live + Soundtrack is available now! 🎶
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35809888/14d74e66ef331f3857a335dedff1d6c3ae2985ef.jpg[/img]

Happy Friday, pie lovers!

Unfortunately, we have been too busy in the last few weeks to continue working on updates for [b]Hell Pie[/b]... You know, with things like surviving gamescom in an alcoholic stupor, counting the massive amounts of money we earned with [b]Hell Pie[/b], ... The usual (indie game dev) stuff.

But (surprisingly) somehow we made it! And so I proudly present the [b]Hell Pie[/b] update version 1.1.3:

[list][*] Added a Squirrel outfit for Nate and a Bee outfit for Nugget 
[*] Added Superhero outfits for Nate and Nugget
[*] Club Luxoria collision fix (it was possible to get stuck behind a toilet)
[*] Various dialogue fixes
[*] Improved sharpness for various textures
[*] Various minor level design fixes[/list]
Compared to the last update, the changes here are quite manageable, that's true.... But hey, with this update you get two damn cool new outfits:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35809888/630da16be667583f168a50343f7f323b35738130.jpg[/img]

And finally - for all those of you that can't exist without the catchy and calm tunes of the [b]Hell Pie[/b] soundtrack anymore - there is a good news: As of now, the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2104580/Hell_Pie_Soundtrack/][u][b]Hell Pie soundtrack[/b][/u][/url] is available here on Steam. So, treat yourself:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2104580/Hell_Pie_Soundtrack/

Have a great time swinging with Nate and Nugget!
Sluggerfly out ❤️

Oi lovers of the pie,

You, who have spent hour after hour swinging through [b]Hell Pie[/b] and collecting the finest ingredients for Satan's hellish birthday pie, you will now receive an additional reward: The greatest and most incredible Steam Community Items since Steam Community even exist!

[b]The hellish hot Hell Pie Steam Community Items include:[/b]
[list][*] 6 Emoticons
[*] 3 Profile Backgrounds
[*] 7 Trading Cards

See you all in Hell (Pie)!

notes.title: Nate & Nugget have been busy: Hell Pie Update 1.1.2 is live! 🛠️
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35809888/70b776343a9d12cbbb8b5e75fd3b1bd8b894dc1b.jpg[/img]

Happy Tuesday, platformers!

As announced last week Nate and Nugget have been f*cking busy working on the first update for [b]Hell Pie[/b]. Therefore, we're gonna save you all the blah-blah and proudly present you the changelog for [b]Hell Pie[/b] version 1.1.2:

[list][*] Added options to disable auto cam rotation
[*] Added option to disable cupid speech bubble
[*] Various dialogue/loca errors fixed
[*] Passive Dialogue Speed increased
[*] Pus bladders in whale level don't respawn anymore
[*] Fixed some bugs that occured when trying to use first person cam while aiming with weapons and vice versa
[*] Fixed a bug where the ingredient in the Da Gina's boss level was lost when leaving the level before collecting it. It can now be found in the start room
[*] Destructible wall in Da Gina's should now reset correctly
[*] Nugget dialogue events are now triggered only once
[*] Nugget dialogue box position tweaked
[*] Patched some holes in various maps
[*] Fixed a bug where the ingriedent list pages were visible in the map
[*] Fixed GameMode/GameState compatibility issue
[*] Fixed a bug where the devil wouldn't appear after respawn at the beginning
[*] Fixed a bug where door tickets in Dr.Jell wouldn't spawn, breaking the game
[*] Cannons now use inverse controls correctly
[*] Fixed a bug where stage 3 of the gluttony boss fight could not be finished
[*] Fixed a bug where the second valve would spawn twice in Restaurant Mange Allieurs
[*] Quest dependent exclamation marks are now intitialized correctly
[*] Dr.Jell Operation UI tweaked (maggot and timer position)
[*] Fixed a missing death zone in Connection Lost, that would let you fall out of the level
[*] Paperstack Collision improved in Connection Lost
[*] Closed a hole in Sin Inc. that let you get the Pus Eye ingredient without the needed horns
[*] Decorated the Yogurt location in Sin Inc. to make it more obvious that something can be found there
[*] Added missing Muncher Dialogue in Sewer
[*] More interactable Objects are now highlighted with a shader (bongo, pipe, ass and bell mini-games, nuclear barrels)
[*] HUB Jungle Demon in Cage that drops a Lucky Cat has now an exclamation mark
[*] Fixed a bug where portable NPCs would reset their positions after pickup
[*] Fixed a bug where useable icon was visible on item after fast respawn and pickup
[*] Fixed speakers not pulsating with the beat in Club Luxoria
[*] Fixed a bug where NPCs would remain stunned after respawn
[*] Fixed a soft lock in Greed door dialogue for russian language
[*] Added ceiling collision in Club Lucoria starting room
[*] Set correct soundclass for Greed door openin/closing sound
[*] Disabled collisions in GLuttony's room, after Gluttony is not there anymore after the fight with him
[*] Moved Dr.Jell level exit (in Jungle), so that the camera isn't behind the black plane after leaving the level 
[*] Moved Gluttony level exit (in Flavour Peaks), so that the cam isn't behind the black plane after leaving the level
[*] Moved Restaurant Mange Ailleurs level exit (in Flavour Peaks), so that the cam isn't behind the black plane after leaving the level
[*] Closed gap in the Sewer death zone, so that playes can't fall through the ground
[*] Nugget dialogue in Connection Lost fixed (No more mentioning of Light Horns)
[*] Made God level exit trigger bigger[/list]
We received a lot of feedback by all of you players out there. Thanks so much for supporting us with your love, reported bugs and issues, your money and praise. That's really appreciated! ❤️

See you all in Hell (Pie)!
Sluggerfly out

notes.title: First Hell Pie Update to be released soon + emotional words from Sluggerfly! ❤️
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35809888/6d23582d3b5b03afc857136ac6ba17d0531415e2.jpg[/img]

Greetings platformers!

We hope you had a lovely week so far. We definitely have! Honestly, we are so [b]F*CKING BLOWN AWAY[/b] by the awesome feedback we received (and receive) for [b]Hell Pie[/b]! Holy moly! When working on a game like [b]Hell Pie[/b], you constantly get comments like [i]"Grow up!"[/i], [i]"I can't see how this is funny!"[/i] or [i]"What kind of late-pubescent garbage is this?"[/i]. And even worse. Not that we're not used to it....

But: We are damn proud of this "late-pubescent garbage" that we've done! [b]In your face, you bores and buzzkills![/b]

And that's exactly why it's so good to see that we get such awesome feedback. Hey, we've been working on [b]Hell Pie[/b] for 5 long years. Sure, it's nothing compared to Duke Nukem Forever, but it's still a long time.

But no one is flawless. And so, even after all the years of hard work and endless optimization, there are still a few bugs hidden in [b]Hell Pie[/b]. (And not just the one in the server room!) But because we love you all soooooo much (and because we got some reports, ideas and feedback from you) we are working on the first update which should be released soon. But there is no exact date yet. At the latest when the residual alcohol from the release party has finally disappeared from our bloodstream... (Man, it was a hell of a night... But, what happens in Essen stays in Essen!)

[b]Among other things, we will address the following issues with the first update:[/b]
[list][*] The dialogs of Nugget will be deactivatable
[*] The Auto Cam will be deactivatable
[*] The dialogs of Nugget will - if activated - be triggered less often
[*] The bug of the no longer spawning tickets at Dr. Jell will be fixed[/list]
Other than that, we're cleaning up some small stuff in [b]Hell Pie[/b]: spelling mistakes, missing translations, holes in the maps (wherever they come from...). We will of course let you know asap once the update is available!

And I can almost smell the question growing in your heads: Will there be more content for [b]Hell Pie[/b] in the future? A good question, but so far there is no answer. There will definitely be updates with more costumes. But whether there will be new levels, DLCs, etc. will ultimately be decided by how successful [b]Hell Pie[/b] will be overall. We have a lot of ideas, that's for sure. We will keep you up to date.

Have a great time swinging with Nate and Nugget!
Sluggerfly out

notes.title: 😈 STEAM NEXT FEST: Demo updated with some minor fixes and improvements! 👼
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35809888/d1d6f8474a1c19ebb299885ff0857e46ea512e6f.jpg[/img]

Hey hey hellish platformers,

we've just added a small update with fixes and improvements to our (close to perfect!) [b]Hell Pie[/b] demo to make yours and Nate's live more comfortable:

[list][*] Fixed a bug that stuck the player when diying at the same moment the sewers boss died
[*] Fixed some minor level design issues
[*] Added some minor text corrections[/list]
And that's it. Quite the list, hm? Yeah, we are also very proud of ourselves! We are now chilling out again. After all, we've earned it. Game developement is a ******* tough business! You wouldn't believe...

If you find any further bugs or problems in the [b]Hell Pie[/b] demo, a) we are really proud of you and b) please tell us about it: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/889910/Hell_Pie/][b]Steam Community[/b][/url] or our [url=https://discord.gg/ZKkWPnUj][b]Discord channel[/b][/url] - we don't care.

Till then and take care everyone!
The Sluggerfly Team
